name: SiteChat – AI Marketing Assistant, Live Chat, Chatbot & Analytics for your Website
author: sitechat

sections.description:
Stop Losing Customers. Start Growing Your Business.

SiteChat is your AI Marketing Assistant that helps you get more customers, increase sales, and grow your business – and you can literally talk to it using voice or text.

Why You Need SiteChat:

🚀 Get More Customers
Ask your AI marketing assistant: “How do I get more customers?” and get intelligent, actionable advice based on your actual website data. Find out what’s working, what’s not, and what to do next.

🔍 Outsmart Your Competition
Discover what your competitors are doing to attract customers. SiteChat monitors competitor websites and rankings so you can stay one step ahead and capture market share they’re missing.

💰 Increase Your Sales
The AI chatbot helps visitors find exactly what they’re looking for and answers their questions instantly – turning browsers into buyers. Studies show that websites with live chat convert up to 3x more visitors into customers.

📈 Stop Guessing, Start Knowing
Ask “Why aren’t I getting more sales?” or “Which pages are losing customers?” – your AI assistant analyzes visitor behavior and tells you exactly what to fix to improve conversions.

📱 Never Miss an Opportunity
Get instant notifications on your phone when someone needs help, places an order, or when something important happens on your website. Respond immediately and close more deals.

🎯 Understand What Customers Actually Want
See in real-time what pages visitors are viewing, what they’re searching for, and where they’re getting stuck. Use these insights to give customers exactly what they want.

How SiteChat Helps You Make More Money:

✅ Turn More Visitors Into Customers: AI chatbot answers questions 24/7, helping visitors find products and make buying decisions
✅ Recover Lost Sales: Engage visitors before they leave – chat with them, answer objections, and save the sale
✅ Get Better Rankings: Track your Google rankings and get advice on how to rank higher than competitors
✅ Make Smarter Marketing Decisions: Ask your AI assistant which marketing channels are working and where to invest your budget
✅ Save Time: Talk to your website instead of logging into multiple dashboards – “How many orders this week?” Done.
✅ Know Your Numbers: Instantly see orders, revenue, traffic, and all your key metrics without lifting a finger

Talk to Your AI Marketing Assistant:

Just ask (using voice or text):
– “How do I get more customers for my business?”
– “What are my competitors doing that I’m not?”
– “Show me today’s orders and revenue”
– “Why are visitors leaving my product page?”
– “What should I do to improve my rankings?”
– “Which marketing campaigns are working best?”

Everything You Need to Grow:

📊 Live Visitor Tracking – See who’s on your site right now and what they’re interested in
🏆 Google Ranking Tracker – Monitor your search rankings and outrank competitors
🛒 Order Management – View and manage WooCommerce orders directly in SiteChat
💬 AI Chatbot – Automatically trained on your website to answer visitor questions 24/7
📞 Live Chat – Take over conversations on your mobile when the AI needs help
🎯 Competitor Monitoring – Track what competitors are doing to steal your customers
📈 Smart Analytics – Get daily briefings with insights that actually help you grow

👉 Watch a 1-minute demo
👉 Get SiteChat from Google Play
👉 Get SiteChat from The Apple App Store
👉 Or use the SiteChat Web App

Start with a 14-day free trial – no credit card required.

Get the App and Free Trial

👉 Download the SiteChat app and start your 14-day free trial today!
– Download on the App Store
– Get it on Google Play

External Services

This plugin integrates with the SiteChat app, a powerful AI chatbot and live visitor tracking platform. It adds a script to your website that loads from cdn.sitechat.io and connects to the SiteChat API.

By using SiteChat, you agree to the terms outlined in our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Settings → SiteChat and paste your SiteChat link code
  4. (Optional) If using WooCommerce, enable order tracking in the settings

That’s it! Your AI marketing assistant is now active on your website.
sections.faq:
Do I need to download the SiteChat App?

You can use either the mobile app (iOS/Android) or the web app at sitechat.io. The mobile app gives you the best experience with voice commands and push notifications for orders and visitor activity.

Where do I find my SiteChat link code?

Once logged into the SiteChat app, click on the Website tab, select your website, and then click Add to your Website. Choose WordPress to get your unique link code.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes! SiteChat has full WooCommerce integration. Enable order tracking in the plugin settings to automatically send order data to SiteChat, where you can view orders, track sales, and get customer insights.

Can I really talk to my website?

Absolutely! Using voice or text, you can ask SiteChat anything about your website: “How many visitors today?”, “Show me my orders”, “What’s my ranking for [keyword]?”, and much more. The AI understands natural language and gives you intelligent answers.

What kind of marketing insights does SiteChat provide?

SiteChat tracks live visitors, Google rankings, competitor performance, order analytics, traffic patterns, conversion data, and more. You get daily briefings with the most important insights, and you can ask specific questions anytime.

Is there a free trial?

Yes! SiteChat offers a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required to start.
